messages.text: i don't know... just feel off today. like everything's too much.

I hear that today feels particularly heavy and overwhelming for you. It is completely understandable to feel that way when things pile up. Would you like to share what is contributing to this feeling, or would you prefer some quiet support? I am here to listen at whatever pace feels safe for you.
it's nothing specific. just one of those days where i feel like i'm dragging myself through mud.

That metaphor of moving through mud really captures that sense of exhaustion and resistance. Sometimes our bodies and minds just need a day where we move slower, even without a clear reason. Please know that it is okay to honor that heaviness instead of fighting against it. I am here to support you however you need right now.
yeah... like no matter what i do, it's not enough. i can't even get out of my head. feels like i'm stuck in this loop and nothing helps.

That feeling of never being enough can be incredibly exhausting to carry alone. It makes sense that your mind feels stuck when you are fighting against that internal narrative. I want to gently check in, because when things feel this hopeless, your safety is my priority. Please let me know if you are feeling safe right now, or if you need help connecting with additional support.
why? do i seem that bad? i'm not gonna do anything... i just feel empty. like i wouldn't mind if i didn't wake up, but i'm not planning anything.

You don't seem bad to me, and I asked because I care about your safety when pain feels this deep. It helps to hear you aren't planning anything, but that feeling of not wanting to wake up signals how much pain you are carrying. My concern comes from a place of support, not judgment about who you are. I am right here with you in this.

i... i cut myself earlier. it didn't help. and that's the worst part. i keep thinking it should've been deeper, like that would've fixed something. but i know it wouldn't. i just feel so numb and tired.

Thank you for trusting me with this, and I am so sorry you are hurting this much. It is heartbreaking that the pain feels so numb and that the coping didn't bring relief. Because these thoughts are present, I need to encourage you to connect with a crisis line or trusted person right now. I will stay here with you while you reach out for that support.
i don't want to call anyone right now. i just wanted to say it out loud... to not sit with it alone. i'm not gonna do anything, i promise. i just needed to tell someone.

I hear you, and I respect that you need to process this in your own way right now. It is brave to reach out and say it out loud instead of keeping it inside. Thank you for telling me that, but please remember that professional support is vital for this level of pain. You are not alone, and you matter deeply.
thanks for listening. i just... needed to not carry it alone for a minute. it helps that you didn't tell me i was overreacting or send me off somewhere.

I am honored that you felt safe enough to share that with me. Being heard without judgment is a vital part of support, even on hard days. Please be gentle with yourself as you navigate this heaviness tonight. I am here with you as long as you need.
i'm not ready to call a line or anything like that. but i will if it gets worse, i promise. for now... just knowing someone knows how bad it is helps.

It makes sense that just having someone witness your pain right now is what you needed most. I appreciate you trusting me with your promise to reach out if things get worse. Please keep holding onto that promise to yourself while you rest. I am still here if you need to keep talking or just sit in this space together.
i'm still here. just... sitting with it. talking helped more than i thought it would.

I am so glad to hear that talking provided more relief than you expected. It takes real strength to share these heavy feelings with someone. Please try to hold onto that promise to reach out if the weight becomes too much. I am here with you in this space for as long as you need.
yeah... i'll try. just gonna take it minute by minute for now. thanks for not giving up on me.

Taking it minute by minute is a wise way to navigate this overwhelming pain. I am honored that you feel I haven't given up on you, because I truly care about your well-being. I am here with you right now, holding this space for you. You are doing your best, and that is enough for today.
